title: Fabulous!
text: We had a wonderful private tour with Carolina. She was very knowledgeable and fun! She guided us through the busy city of Barcelona and it was truly a highlight of our trip. We highly recommend.
author: Jodi_M

title: fun, relaxing, and safe bike tour!
text: enjoyed a lovely afternoon with the one and only Max :) he's funny, informative, safety-oriented, and a great person to spend time with! he has years of experience and showed us a lot of quintessential landmarks around town. he was super sweet and also sent us a bunch of recommendations for things to do/eat in barcelona! he is also one of the best photographers and offered to take so many pics for us. all in all, great time and would absolutely recommend booking with him :)
author: M7901NPangelab

title: Do this bike tour!
text: This was a great way to see more of Barcelona!!! Max is a super easy going and fun guide. He set everything up really nicely. We saw lots of cool spots in Barcelona and Max had lots of great knowledge about the history, architecture etc. He also knows so much about current culture in Barcelona and gave us a bunch of recs for unique spots to see and places to eat/drink. Would easily recommend this tour!
